research_question: Can a relevance-supervised rank-16 int8 sidecar recover Top-10 boundary errors under the same document-byte budget as PCA and RARS-v1?

allowed_data.development_source: MS MARCO 1M clean deterministic train and validation splits
allowed_data.new_external_test: TBD and unopened until the v2 method and evaluator are frozen
allowed_data.beir_nq_train_exclusion_reason: its qrels reference a different corpus; 117750 positive documents were absent from the frozen 2.68M NQ confirmation corpus

training.primary_loss: pairwise softplus loss over relevant candidates and hard non-relevant Top-10 boundary candidates
training.negative_source: non-relevant candidates nearest the frozen Top-10 boundary
training.quantization: learned fixed per-coefficient symmetric int8 scales reused unchanged for full-corpus encoding and validation
training.quantization_scale_selection: initialized from a deterministic train-residual sample and optimized by QAT; validation does not recalibrate scales
training.epoch_selection: highest inner-validation int8 Recall@10; ties choose earliest epoch

development_artifact_policy.residual_scope: union of train or validation Top-100 candidate rows
development_artifact_policy.inner_split: deterministic hash 80/20 partition inside the original 4980-query train split
development_artifact_policy.original_1000_query_validation_role: outer diagnostic only; never selects epoch or optimizer settings
